proofs.text: Over the same file list, grep `os\.system\s*\(` in Python and `system\s*\(` and `passthru\s*\(` in PHP; verify zero matches, naming the file on failure

rule_text: No file under `scripts/` calls the builtin that hands a whole command line to the operating system shell: no `os.system(` in Python, no `system(` or `passthru(` in PHP
